icons.name: bell
icons.description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: One continuous silhouette integrates the top hanger to avoid doubled seams. Straight side walls meet softened shoulders and a straight lower lip; the separate clapper remains recognizable. Vertical bounds y=2.5..21.5 are centered. Review study; not owner-approved.

icons.name: camera
icons.description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm. The left and right shoulders have explicit 3-unit horizontal ledges at y=6.8 (x=5..8 and x=16..19), with a narrower raised housing to keep both straight spans visible. The indicator is a circular stroke mark centered at 17.9,9.5 with radius 0.15; it stays a solid circular dot across the Thin/Regular/Bold presets. The circular lens is centered at 12,13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Review study; not owner-approved.

icons.name: folder
icons.description: A horizontal rounded folder with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Owner-approved horizontal Folder. Single rounded outer contour with a straight front-panel edge at y=10.9. Bounds x=3..21, y=4.3..19.7; default stroke is 1.7, with visible left/right padding 2.15 and top/bottom 3.45. The approved X=100%, Y=110% geometry is baked into the path coordinates, preserving constant stroke width and the existing part names.

review.note: Owner approved both styles. Y scaling and constant stroke/gap have been baked into the source; the approved shape is now 100% in the Lab.

icons.name: heart
icons.description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Broad, gently squared lobe shoulders and short upright sections carry the rounded rectangle grammar without losing the heart notch and soft point. Bounds x=3.25..20.75, y=4.1..19.9 are centered. Review study; not owner-approved.

icons.name: search
icons.description: A clear circular search lens with a short angled handle.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: The circular lens is an intentional silhouette exception. A single 45-degree handle meets the circle at its centerline, with a rounded free end. Combined centerline bounds x/y=3.3..20.7 balance the grid. Review study; not owner-approved.

icons.name: settings
icons.description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center.
icons.authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
icons.construction: Six original radial teeth use straight faces with individually rounded transitions. The recognizable gear is a silhouette exception to the rounded rectangle baseline. Opposite teeth are constructed in symmetric pairs about 12,12; the circular hub remains circular. Review study; not owner-approved.
